actions.action: Add a “Move to position…” command to every item.
actions.mechanism: Direct numeric placement avoids traversing 40 items.
actions.implementation: Open a keyboard-operable dialog with an integer field from 1–40 showing the current position. Enter commits; Escape cancels. Reinsert the existing item ID at the requested final position, record the move in session undo history, and return focus to its command.
actions.check: Using only the keyboard, move item 37 to position 4, then undo. Verify the exact previous ID sequence and retained focus.
actions.risk: Clarify that positions are one-based and describe the final list; reject invalid values without changing order.

actions.action: Offer “Move before…” and “Move after…” another item.
actions.mechanism: A named destination lets users choose placement without calculating an index.
actions.implementation: Provide a keyboard-searchable destination list excluding the moving item, plus a before/after choice. Disambiguate duplicate titles with current positions. Resolve destinations by stable ID, commit one undoable move, and restore focus to the moved item.
actions.check: Move an item after a duplicate-titled destination using only the keyboard. Verify the selected destination ID is adjacent, then undo and compare the complete prior sequence.
actions.risk: Search results must expose enough context to distinguish similarly named items.

actions.action: Provide an explicit keyboard reorder mode.
actions.mechanism: Incremental movement supports choosing a position while reviewing neighboring items.
actions.implementation: An item’s “Reorder with keyboard” button enters the mode. Arrow keys move it one place; Home/End move it first/last. Announce title and position through a polite live region. Enter commits one undoable transaction; Escape restores the entry order. Keep focus attached to the same ID.
actions.check: Move an item several positions, cancel, and verify no order change. Repeat, commit, then undo; verify all 40 IDs and their original sequence.
actions.risk: Intercept navigation keys only inside the explicit mode; avoid excessive announcements.

actions.action: Keep a page-lifetime undo history for every committed reorder.
actions.mechanism: Stored order snapshots make successive moves reversible without reconstructing their effects.
actions.implementation: Before each committed move, retain the ordered ID array in memory without a history cap or timeout. Provide a keyboard-focusable “Undo last reorder” button. Undo restores the previous sequence using existing item records and preserves focus by ID. Announce completion; clear history only when the page closes.
actions.check: Perform 100 mixed reorder operations, then undo all 100. Assert each intermediate sequence matches its snapshot and the final sequence equals the starting sequence, with identical IDs.
actions.risk: Unbounded history consumes memory; store IDs rather than copied item content.
